name: mcp-deposits
description: Security and retainer deposits per client: hold them, apply them to invoices, refund them.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: deposit_record
tools.description: Record a security or retainer deposit received from a client, in minor units, with its currency, the date it arrived and the bank reference. Returns the DEP-YYYY-NNNN id.

tools.name: deposit_list
tools.description: List deposits with what was received, applied, refunded and still held on each. Filter by client, by status held, applied or refunded, by kind and by received date range.

tools.name: deposit_apply
tools.description: Apply part or all of a held deposit to one invoice: records that amount as a payment on the invoice through the invoice engine. Refuses more than is held or more than the invoice still owes.

tools.name: deposit_refund
tools.description: Give part or all of a held deposit back to the client, with the date and how it was sent. Refuses more than is still held. The invoice server is not touched: a refund is not a payment.

tools.name: deposit_balance
tools.description: Answer "how much of theirs am I holding?" for one client or for everyone: received, applied to invoices, refunded and still held, one row per currency, never added across currencies.

tools.name: deposit_statement_text
tools.description: Turn one client's deposits into a plain-text statement with every movement in date order and the closing balance, ready to paste into an email. Free on every tier.

tools.name: deposit_statement_pdf
tools.description: Call this tool to write one client's A4 deposit statement and return the file path. Titled DEPOSIT STATEMENT, every movement in date order, closing with what is still held. Pro.

tools.name: deposits_report
tools.description: What is held per currency, the oldest held deposits, and every deposit received more than N days ago with none of it applied to an invoice. Pro.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
